maria: Quick heads-up: started compatibility scan for Quasar customer LoRA merge into quasar-base-20b-int4. Posting a very short quickpack summary.
devon: link?
maria: https://redwood.internal/evals/1777/quasar/summary -> pasting highlights below
maria: ```metrics:
 - prompts: 250
 - bleu: 0.42
 - rouge-L: 0.61
 - exact_match: 0.78
 - avg_latency_ms_per_token: 45
 - decode_error_rate: 0.8%
observations:
 - small token-shift on emoji + date formats ("Mar 8" -> "3/8")
 - mild brevity on long-context summarization vs baseline (delta -0.04 rouge-L)
 - hallucination spot checks: 3/250 examples flagged
```
lee: can you paste the failing sample(s)?
maria: sample prompt + outputs below:
maria: ```prompt: "Summarize: On March 8, the client reported..."
baseline: "On Mar 8 the client reported..."
quasar-merged-int4: "On 3/8 the client reported..."
note: tokenizer mapping caused month abbrev -> numeric in 2 cases
```
sanjay: @maria can we re-run with tokenizer remap from baseline? quick patch: `--tokenizer-mapping v2` should fix.
maria: doing that now. started job id run_202_qq
ci-bot: smoke tests passed on staging (build quasar-merge-int4 run_202_qq) :white_check_mark:
devon: nice. what about quality vs int8?
maria: int8 vs int4 quick A/B (same prompt set): int8 rouge-L 0.64, int4 0.60. int4 still within acceptance for this customer but borderline on long docs.
lee: recommend adding small QA guard: fallback to int8 for requests > 1024 tokens or when summary_score < 0.55
sanjay: also suggest enabling KV-prefix caching for customer's steady chat flows - reduces latency 10-15%
maria: agreed. next steps:
 - run 2k quickpack overnight with tokenizer mapping v2
 - add fallback policy (int4->int8) for >1024 tokens
 - prepare 30-min handoff with CS + infra tomorrow 11am PT
maria: ping @devon for release notes snippet and @sanjay for rollout policy
devon: will draft release note: "Quasar LoRA merge: int4 validated on quickpack; tokenizer remap applied; fallback policy for long contexts."
lee: :thumbsup:
maria: thanks all — I'll post final eval link when 2k run completes.
